create_dataset_from_hub: create a Dataset from a Hugging Face Hub repository using from_hub with repo name and token
create_dataset_from_cache: create a Dataset from the local Hugging Face cache using from_cache with optional download flag
scan_dataset_sync: run a synchronous scan on a Dataset with optional limit, offset, and scan size limit parameters
index_dataset_sync: run a synchronous index operation on a Dataset with optional file list and max parallelism settings
review_dataset_class: review the Dataset class that extends PyDataset to read parquet files with page pruning from Hub or cache
